label: Pickup locker
intent: The locker releases its parcel. Light: the latch bolt drops to unlock, then the door springs open along its track, hits its stop and bounces once, while the bolt springs back up. Strong: the bolt is lifted first and snaps down, the door pops ajar with a click, pauses, then slides open hard and bounces twice against its stop. The frame never moves; the door and latch stay rigid and hold open.

handle.//: the latch bolt slides in the door
